name: d280-source-pixel-tracks
command:
from PIL import Image
import itertools,json
for f in [24,25]:
 im=Image.open(f".tmp/STEMROBIN-181/d1816-d276/root/10p/figures/fig-{f}.png").convert("L")
 print("FIG",f,"size",im.size)
 if f==25:
  for kind,k in [("row",80),("row",110),("row",300),("row",340),("col",180),("col",200),("col",218),("col",250),("col",300)]:
   n=im.width if kind=="row" else im.height
   pts=[i for i in range(n) if im.getpixel((i,k) if kind=="row" else (k,i))<128]
   runs=[[g[0][1],g[-1][1]] for _,it in itertools.groupby(enumerate(pts),lambda z:z[1]-z[0]) if (g:=list(it))]
   print(kind,k,json.dumps(runs))
